digest.component_or_area: MCP adapter / transition_ticket and claim_ticket handlers
propositions: transition_ticket and claim_ticket MCP signatures lack force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters already supported by the library and CLI
FastMCP derives JSON schemas from handwritten callable signatures, causing undeclared parameters to be discarded before the adapter runs
The MCP adapter bodies forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so parameter additions to signatures alone will not reach the core without adapter changes
Runtime probes confirm the mechanism: live schemas omit all reported fields, MCP ref selects HEAD instead of the requested commit, and MCP caused_by closes without writing the edge
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the old CLI/library-only force policy and establishes total lib/CLI/MCP parity with absent certification as the audit signal
